info.title: SmartCity Backend API
info.description: REST API for managing public buildings and energy devices in a smart city

put.summary: Update energy consumption of a building
put.description: Updates the energy consumption value and unit for a specific public building identified by its UUID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the public building whose consumption is to be updated.

requestBody.description: The new energy consumption value and unit to assign to the building.

200.description: Energy consumption updated successfully for the specified building.

400.description: Invalid request data, such as a negative consumption value or an unsupported energy unit.

example.message: Validation failed: consumption value must be non-negative.

404.description: No public building found with the provided UUID.

example.message: Public building with id 'a3f1c2d4-5e6b-7890-abcd-ef1234567890' was not found.

patch.summary: Update energy consumption of a building
patch.description: Updates the energy consumption value and unit for a specific public building. The request must include the current version of the building to prevent concurrent modification conflicts.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the public building whose consumption is being updated

204.description: Energy consumption updated successfully. No content is returned.

422.description: Unprocessable Entity — The provided consumption value or unit is semantically invalid (e.g., negative consumption value or unsupported energy unit).

example.message: Consumption value must be greater than or equal to zero.

400.description: Bad Request — The request body is malformed or contains missing required fields such as consumptionValue, consumptionUnit, or version.

example.message: Field 'consumptionUnit' must not be null.

404.description: Not Found — No public building exists with the specified identifier.

example.message: Public building with id '3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6' was not found.

409.description: Conflict — The provided version does not match the current version of the building, indicating a concurrent modification conflict. Retrieve the latest version and retry.

example.message: Optimistic locking conflict: building has been modified by another request. Expected version 2 but found 3.

post.description: Registers a new public building in the smart city system. Requires ADMIN role. Returns the UUID of the newly created building.

201.description: Public building successfully created. Returns the UUID of the new building.

422.description: Business rule violation. The provided building data failed domain validation (e.g. duplicate name, invalid energy unit, or constraint conflict).

example.message: A public building with the name 'City Hall' already exists.

400.description: Invalid request payload. One or more required fields are missing or have invalid values (e.g. blank name, null location).

example.message: Validation failed: 'name' must not be blank; 'location' must not be null.

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all public buildings registered in the smart city system. Optionally filter by energy eligibility status.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of the page to be returned

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sorting criteria in the format: property,(asc|desc). Default sort order is ascending. Multiple sort criteria are supported.

parameters.name: eligible
parameters.description: Filter buildings by energy eligibility status. When true, returns only buildings eligible for energy production programs.

200.description: A paginated list of public buildings was successfully retrieved.

post.summary: Add an energy device to a building
post.description: Registers a new energy device (e.g. solar panel, wind turbine, battery) and associates it with the specified public building. The building must exist and must not already contain a device with the same identifier.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the public building to which the device will be added.

204.description: Device successfully added to the building. No content is returned.

400.description: The request is malformed or contains invalid field values (e.g. missing required fields, invalid UUID format).

example.message: deviceId must not be null

404.description: No public building was found with the provided identifier.

example.message: Public building with id '3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6' was not found.

409.description: A device with the same identifier is already registered to this building.

example.message: Device with id '9b1deb4d-3b7d-4bad-9bdd-2b0d7b3dcb6d' already exists in building '3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6'.

422.description: The request is syntactically valid but violates business rules (e.g. production value is negative, unsupported energy unit).

example.message: Production value must be greater than zero.

patch.summary: Update production rate of a device
patch.description: Updates the energy production rate of a specific device installed in a public building. The building and device must exist, and the provided version must match the current aggregate version to prevent concurrent modification conflicts.

parameters.name: buildingId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the public building that owns the device

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the energy device whose production rate will be updated

204.description: Device production rate updated successfully. No content is returned.

400.description: Invalid request payload — e.g. missing required fields, malformed UUID, or negative production value.

example.message: productionValue must be greater than or equal to 0

404.description: The specified building or device was not found.

example.message: Device with id 'b7e2d3f5-6a7c-8901-bcde-f01234567891' not found in building 'a3f1c2d4-5e6b-7890-abcd-ef1234567890'

409.description: Optimistic locking conflict — the provided version does not match the current aggregate version, indicating a concurrent modification.

example.message: Building aggregate version mismatch: expected 3 but was 4. Please reload and retry.

422.description: Business rule violation — e.g. the production value exceeds the device's rated capacity or the device is not in a state that allows production changes.

example.message: Production value 500.00 KWH exceeds the maximum rated capacity of the device.

get.summary: Get a public building by ID
get.description: Retrieves the full details of a single public building, including its energy consumption, production data, and associated devices.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the public building to retrieve.

200.description: The public building was found and its details are returned successfully.

404.description: No public building was found with the specified ID.

example.message: Public building with ID '3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6' does not exist.

delete.description: Permanently removes a public building from the system by its unique identifier. The request body must include a confirmation or version field to prevent accidental deletion. Returns no content on success.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the public building to delete

204.description: The public building was successfully deleted. No content is returned.

422.description: The deletion request could not be processed due to invalid input, such as a missing or malformed version field.

example.message: Version field is required and must be a non-negative integer.

404.description: No public building was found with the specified identifier.

example.message: Public building with id 'a3f1c2d4-5e6b-7890-abcd-ef1234567890' does not exist.

409.description: The deletion could not be completed due to an optimistic locking conflict. The building was modified by another request since it was last read. Retrieve the latest version and retry.

example.message: Optimistic locking conflict: the building has been modified. Expected version 3 but found version 4.

get.description: Retrieves a list of all registered public buildings in the smart city, including their energy consumption details and associated devices.

200.description: A list of all public buildings was successfully retrieved.

post.summary: Exchange a refresh token for a new JWT + new refresh token
post.description: Accepts a valid refresh token and issues a new short-lived JWT access token together with a rotated refresh token. The previous refresh token is invalidated immediately after use. Use this endpoint to silently renew a session without requiring the user to re-enter credentials.

requestBody.description: The refresh token previously issued during login or a prior token refresh.

200.description: Token refresh successful. Returns a new JWT access token and a rotated refresh token. The client should replace both stored tokens immediately.

post.summary: Revoke the current JWT and its refresh token
post.description: Invalidates the provided JWT access token and its associated refresh token, effectively ending the user's session. After a successful logout, the tokens can no longer be used to authenticate requests.

requestBody.description: The refresh token to be revoked along with the current JWT session.

200.description: Tokens successfully revoked. The user's session has been terminated and the provided JWT and refresh token are no longer valid.

post.summary: Authenticate and receive a JWT + refresh token
post.description: Validates the provided credentials and, on success, returns a signed JWT access token along with a refresh token that can be used to obtain new access tokens without re-entering credentials.

requestBody.description: User credentials required to authenticate and obtain tokens.

200.description: Authentication successful. Returns a signed JWT access token and a refresh token for the authenticated user.

post.summary: Register a new account with email and password
post.description: Creates a new user account using the provided email and password. On successful registration, returns an authentication token that can be used for subsequent authenticated requests.

200.description: Account successfully created. Returns an authentication token along with basic user information.

delete.summary: Remove an energy device from a building
delete.description: Removes a specific energy device from a public building. The device is identified by its unique ID within the context of the given building. Returns no content on success.

parameters.name: buildingId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the public building from which the device will be removed.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the energy device to be removed from the building.

204.description: The energy device was successfully removed from the building. No content is returned.

422.description: The request was well-formed but could not be processed. This may occur if the provided version does not match the current aggregate version (optimistic locking failure) or if business rules prevent the removal.

example.message: Optimistic locking conflict: the building has been modified by another request.

404.description: The specified building or device was not found. Either the buildingId or deviceId does not correspond to an existing resource.

example.message: Energy device with ID 'b7e2d3f5-6a7c-8901-bcde-fa2345678901' was not found in building 'a3f1c2d4-5e6b-7890-abcd-ef1234567890'.

409.description: A conflict occurred while attempting to remove the device. This may happen if a concurrent modification was detected on the building aggregate.

example.message: Concurrent modification detected for building 'a3f1c2d4-5e6b-7890-abcd-ef1234567890'. Please retry the operation.

ChangeConsumptionRequest.description: Request payload for updating the energy consumption value and unit of a city asset. The version field is used for optimistic locking to prevent concurrent modification conflicts.

consumptionValue.description: The new energy consumption value for the asset. Must be zero or a positive number.

consumptionUnit.description: The unit of measurement for the energy consumption value (kilowatts, megawatts, or gigawatts).

version.description: The current version number of the asset record, used for optimistic locking. Must match the latest version stored in the system to prevent overwriting concurrent changes.

CreateBuildingRequest.description: Request payload for creating a new building asset in the smart city system.

name.description: The unique human-readable name of the building.

location.description: The physical address or geographic location of the building.

AddDeviceRequest.description: Request payload for adding a new device to a smart city asset

type.description: Category of the device based on its energy function

ratedCapacityValue.description: Numeric value of the device's rated energy capacity; must be a positive number

ratedCapacityUnit.description: Unit of measurement for the rated capacity value

version.description: Optimistic locking version number of the parent asset to prevent concurrent modification conflicts

ChangeProductionRequest.description: Request payload for updating the energy production value of an asset

productionValue.description: The new energy production value for the asset. Must be zero or positive.

productionUnit.description: The unit of measurement for the energy production value.

version.description: Optimistic locking version number of the asset record. Must match the current version to prevent concurrent update conflicts.

EnergyDeviceResponse.description: Represents an energy device asset in the smart city infrastructure, including its rated capacity and production rate specifications.

id.description: Unique identifier of the energy device.

name.description: Human-readable name assigned to the energy device.

type.description: Category of the energy device. SOLAR refers to photovoltaic generation units, PUMP to energy-consuming pump systems, and BATTERY to energy storage units.

ratedCapacityValue.description: Numeric value of the device's rated capacity, representing the maximum power output or storage capacity under standard conditions.

ratedCapacityUnit.description: Unit of measurement for the rated capacity value (kilowatts, megawatts, or gigawatts).

productionRateValue.description: Numeric value of the device's current or nominal energy production rate.

productionRateUnit.description: Unit of measurement for the production rate value (kilowatts, megawatts, or gigawatts).

PublicBuildingResponse.description: Represents a public building asset with its energy consumption details and associated energy devices.

id.description: Unique identifier of the public building.

location.description: Physical address or geographic location of the public building.

consumptionValue.description: Total energy consumption value of the building, expressed in the specified consumption unit.

consumptionUnit.description: Unit of measurement for the building's energy consumption (kilowatts, megawatts, or gigawatts).

devices.description: List of energy devices installed in the public building that contribute to its overall energy consumption.

version.description: Optimistic locking version number used to detect concurrent modifications to the building record.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error response returned when a request fails, containing details about the error code, human-readable message, HTTP status, timestamp, and a unique request identifier for tracing.

errorCode.description: Application-specific error code identifying the type of error.

message.description: Human-readable description of the error providing context about what went wrong.
message.example: Asset with ID 42 was not found in the system.

status.description: HTTP status code associated with the error response.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp indicating when the error occurred.

requestId.description: Unique identifier for the request, useful for correlating logs and tracing the error across services.

RefreshRequest.description: Request payload containing a refresh token used to obtain a new access token

refreshToken.description: The refresh token previously issued during authentication, used to generate a new access token without re-authenticating

LoginResponse.description: Response returned upon successful authentication, containing the JWT access token, user role, token expiry duration, and a refresh token.

token.description: JWT access token to be included in the Authorization header for subsequent authenticated requests.

role.description: The role assigned to the authenticated user, determining their access level within the Smart City platform.

expiresInMs.description: Duration in milliseconds until the access token expires, after which a new token must be obtained using the refresh token.

refreshToken.description: Long-lived refresh token used to obtain a new access token once the current one has expired, without requiring the user to log in again.

LogoutRequest.description: Request payload for logging out a user by invalidating the provided refresh token

refreshToken.description: The refresh token to be invalidated upon logout

LoginRequest.description: Credentials used to authenticate a user. The 'username' field accepts either a plain username (for pre-seeded admin/viewer accounts) or an email address (for self-registered users).

username.description: The account identifier: either a plain username (e.g. 'admin', 'viewer') or the email address used during self-registration.

password.description: The account's plaintext password to be verified against the stored credentials.

PagedResponsePublicBuildingResponse.description: A paginated response containing a list of public building records along with pagination metadata.

content.description: The list of public buildings returned for the current page.

totalElements.description: The total number of public buildings across all pages.

totalPages.description: The total number of pages available based on the current page size.

pageSize.description: The number of public buildings returned per page.

RegisterRequest.description: Request payload for registering a new user account.

email.description: A valid, unique email address that will be used as the user's login identifier.

password.description: The account password. Must be at least 8 characters long.

DeleteBuildingRequest.description: Request payload for deleting a building, requiring the current version for optimistic locking to prevent concurrent modification conflicts.

version.description: The current version number of the building record used for optimistic locking. Must match the latest version in the system to prevent overwriting concurrent updates.

RemoveDeviceRequest.description: Request payload for removing a device from an asset, requiring the current version for optimistic locking

version.description: Current version number of the asset used for optimistic locking to prevent concurrent modification conflicts
